name: Voxel-based Surface Parameterization
definition: A method to transform the world coordinate system to a system defined by one voxel, ensuring every component of every point vhit is in [0,1]. It determines texture coordinates based on the surface normal and the voxel side-plane whose normal is most similar to the surface normal. Voxels are never created explicitly.
summary: Voxel-based Surface Parameterization maps 2D noise to 3D surfaces by implicitly voxelizing the bounding box and selecting texture coordinates based on surface normals, avoiding explicit UV mapping.
